Problem Statement
Print the number of bytes occupied by int, float, and double using the sizeof operator.
Description
This program does not read any input. Use the sizeof operator on the data types int, float, and double, and print the three sizes (in bytes), each on its own line.
Input Description
This program does not read any input.
Output Description
Print the size in bytes of int, float, and double, each on its own line.
